name: PR detail Files changed tab renders Smart Diff groups, collapse, and the order toggle
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm Smart Diff grouping (Rule 1): a role group header ('Docs') renders, collapsing it shows the 'N files' summary, and switching to Original order still shows the seeded file (src/config.ts). Read-only seeded data (no model call, no chat) — the seed spans core/wiring/docs/boilerplate roles so more than one group exists (see server/docs/insights.md). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md). Flow 05 stays the flat-list regression guard; this flow is Smart Diff's own coverage.

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
a Smart Diff role group header renders (README.md's group)
collapsed group shows its file-count summary
switch back to the flat, GitHub-ordered list
the seeded file still renders in Original order
